## Scope

Describe the capability or bug being changed and why the change is bounded.

## Authority impact

- [ ] No authority change.
- [ ] Authority impact is explicitly documented and separately approved.

If authority changes, explain the exact contract and approval.

## Validation

List focused tests, integration checks, replay/fixture validation, `git diff --check`, or other evidence.

## Public / open-core safety

- [ ] No credentials, tokens, cookies, certificates, or secret-bearing config are included.
- [ ] No production database, private portfolio/order data, private operational artifact, or machine-specific sensitive state is included.
- [ ] Any dataset/fixture added is synthetic, redacted, public-domain, or explicitly redistributable.
- [ ] No proprietary third-party code/content was copied into this contribution.
- [ ] New dependencies, if any, have their source/license explained.

## Contribution rights

- [ ] I have the right to submit this contribution and understand that accepted contributions are distributed under the repository's MIT License unless a different written agreement is made before merge.

## Notes / limitations

Record known blockers, fail-closed states, or intentionally deferred work. Do not hide partial evidence behind a success label.
